name: Information Security Management Examination

third_party_evaluations.summary: METI-authorised national exam for information security managers; year-round CBT via IPA.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, foundational: 2. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded national information-security management role and IPA delivery support associate workplace-security responsibility; no experience requirement or recorded advanced assessment justifies professional governance ownership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded national security-management exam offers an entry security knowledge baseline. With zero experience and no practical or advanced-scope factors, the associate hint does not establish applied practitioner responsibility.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded open-entry information-security management exam supplies a baseline governance signal. With no experience or practical component documented, I place it foundational below the associate hint.
